standard_prerequisites.name: Polynomial lifting: every polynomial with coefficients in (R/I)^G lifts to R^G
standard_prerequisites.use: Verifies the hypothesis under which the universally bijective lemma applies to the map R^G/I^G into (R/I)^G.

standard_prerequisites.name: A ring map satisfying the universally bijective hypothesis is integral, induces a homeomorphism on spectra and purely inseparable residue field extensions
standard_prerequisites.use: Provides the conclusion of the lemma.

core_obligations: The invariant ideal satisfies I^G = R^G intersect I, so the induced map R^G/I^G into (R/I)^G is injective (proof lines 32562-32563). The polynomial lifting lemma holds for the G-action on R and I (proof lines 32563-32565), which is exactly the hypothesis the universally bijective algebra lemma requires; applying it to the injective integral extension R^G/I^G into (R/I)^G yields integrality, a homeomorphism on spectra and purely inseparable residue field extensions (proof lines 32563-32566).
proof_roadmap: Get injectivity from I^G = R^G intersect I (proof lines 32562-32563).
Invoke polynomial lifting to meet the hypothesis of the universally bijective lemma and conclude (proof lines 32563-32566).
